diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-repackage/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-repackage/kind.yml
index 0475851f2f1..255f6fc1b60 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-repackage/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-repackage/kind.yml
@@ -38,9 +38,11 @@ kind-dependencies:
 
 only-for-build-platforms:
     - linux64-shippable/opt
+    - linux64-aarch64-shippable/opt
     - macosx64-shippable/opt

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
index 92d652d663a..2e017b73434 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
@@ -256,6 +256,46 @@ linux64-aarch64/opt:
             - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
             - terser
 
+linux64-aarch64-shippable/opt:
+    description: "Linux64 aarch64 Shippable"
+    attributes:
+        shippable: true
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
+        skip-verify-test-packaging: true
+    shipping-phase: build
+    shipping-product: thunderbird
+    index:
+        product: thunderbird
+        job-name: linux64-aarch64-opt
+        type: shippable
+    treeherder:
+        platform: linux64-aarch64-shippable/opt
+        symbol: B
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 9000
+        env:
+            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
+            MOZ_ENABLE_FULL_SYMBOLS: "1"
+    run:
+        config:
+            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
+            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
+            - taskcluster_nightly.py
+        extra-config:
+            mozconfig_platform: linux64-aarch64
+        tooltool-downloads: public
+    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
+    optimization:
+        never: null
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux-aarch64-libotr
+            - linux64-llvm-symbolizer
+            - linux64-rust
+            - sysroot-aarch64-linux-gnu
+            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
+            - terser
+
 linux64-ccov/opt:
     description: "Linux64-CCov Opt"
     index:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
index 39598f49286..a94fe7ebf35 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
@@ -634,3 +634,59 @@ win64-aarch64/opt:
             - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
     optimization:
         never: null
+
+win64-aarch64-shippable/opt:
+    description: "AArch64 Win64 Opt Shippable"
+    index:
+        product: thunderbird
+        job-name: win64-aarch64-opt
+        type: shippable
+    attributes:
+        shippable: true
+        enable-build-signing: true
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
+        skip-verify-test-packaging: true
+    shipping-phase: build
+    shipping-product: thunderbird
+    treeherder:
+        platform: windows2012-aarch64-shippable/opt
+        symbol: B
+        tier: 1
+    worker-type: b-linux
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 9000
+        env:
+            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: aarch64
+            RUST_MIN_STACK: "16777216"
+            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
+    run:
+        actions: [build]
+        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
+        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
+        config:
+            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
+            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
+            - taskcluster_nightly.py
+        extra-config:
+            stage_platform: win64-aarch64
+            mozconfig_platform: win64-aarch64
+    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
+    optimization:
+        never: null
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-7zz
+            - linux64-cbindgen
+            - linux64-clang
+            - linux64-dump_syms
+            - linux64-nasm
+            - linux64-node
+            - linux64-rust-cross
+            - linux64-rust-size
+            - linux64-upx
+            - linux64-winchecksec
+            - linux64-wine
+            - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
+            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
+            - terser
+            - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
